biggest_catch: Only the referrer earns the $50 bill credit - the friend gets no stated reward, and the friend must be a new Texas customer on a qualifying term plan with service active for at least 10 days before anything pays out.
catches: The referrer's own electricity service must be active for at least 10 days to qualify.
The referred customer must be a new Texas customer who enrolls in a qualifying term plan using the referral code and keeps service active for at least 10 days.
The credit is applied within two billing cycles after the referred customer's 10th active day - not immediately.
Rewards limited to eligible Texas residential customers; excludes month-to-month plans, sales agents, and mass or automated referrals.
